correctness.rationale: The four exact energy equalities imply At=Bu and 2D+b_C(t²-u²)=0. Isolation rules out A=B, while transverse crossing gives |b_Ct|>|A|, |b_Cu|>|B| and orientation by sign(b_C). Hamiltonian section derivatives with two outer reflections yield Q; algebra gives sign(µ−1)=sign(B−A), hence µ≠1. Exact rational published-example checks and numeric return differentiation independently corroborate.
